question: How many shaktis are placed in the vidya lotus and where?
premises: They are placed clockwise from the right.
This is in the vidya lotus here.
It was said before and shown again.
inference: Eighteen shaktis are installed clockwise from the right in the vidya lotus.
uncertainties: navakadvayam literally means two nines, i.e. eighteen.
plain_english: Place eighteen shaktis clockwise from the right in the vidya lotus here; that was also said before and is shown again.
